name: Dongwoon Anatech Co., Ltd.
summary: Dongwoon Anatech Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells analog semiconductors in South Korea, China, Taiwan, Japan, and internationally. The company offers ICs for image stabilization, auto focus (AF) control in smartphone cameras, haptic driver ICs for automotive, various motor driver ICs, power management ICs, and ICs for LiDAR and ToF applications, as well as fingerprint recognition and saliva glucose monitoring systems. Dongwoon Anatech Co., Ltd. was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
